decisions.reason: As a mainstream organic cold-cut variant, this product likely revealed enough steady demand by 2022 to justify keeping the option open despite limited public evidence after launch.
Organic Kasseler is a narrower sliced-meat niche, and after roughly three years a large incumbent would likely redeploy capacity if repeat demand has not clearly justified the added complexity.
Organic pepper salami still fits a recognizable, higher-volume salami segment, so the firm would be somewhat more inclined to retain it unless sales data clearly disappoint.
A teriyaki aspic deli specialty looks like a high-uncertainty, low-scale experiment whose value should be largely revealed by now, making abandonment the likely real-options choice.
Fennel-flavoured sliced salami is a differentiated but relatively niche taste profile, and a large German food producer would likely prune it if it did not become a clear winner quickly.
Liver pâté with veal is a premium but narrow subcategory, and by 2022 the firm would likely discontinue it if the extra sourcing and assortment complexity has not paid off.
